name: NordVPN
author: Shaun Hawk <shaun@shaunhawk.com>
description: Control NordVPN from the Omarchy bar: connect, switch servers, auto-connect, Pi-hole/custom DNS, Tailscale coexistence, and live IP status.

barWidget.description: Toggle NordVPN, pick a country, set auto-connect, use Pi-hole or custom DNS, and allowlist Tailscale.

schema.label: Auto-connect country
schema.description: Optional country name or two-letter code used when auto-connect is enabled (for example United States or us).

schema.label: Pi-hole DNS address
schema.description: LAN IPv4 of your Pi-hole (for example 192.168.2.2). The plugin allowlists it before applying DNS so it works while NordVPN is connected.

schema.label: Allow Tailscale alongside NordVPN
schema.description: Opt-in: allowlists Tailscale's 100.64.0.0/10 subnet and UDP 41641 when enabled.
